description: The products and apps of PolarJay as published on its website, each with a link to its page. Optionally one by id or name. Prices appear only where the website publishes them, with the page that says so.

item.description: Id or name from a previous call, optional

locale.description: Answer language: es, en. Default en. A regional form such as en-US is read as en. A language the site does not publish is rejected with the list of the ones it does.
